title: The up and down arrow keys must not switch between horizontal tabs
summary: Pressing the down arrow on a tab to move on through the page instead switches to the next tab, which a reported NVDA user experienced as being trapped in the tab list.
consumer: Author-written planning applications page around the unchanged upstream Tabs source at buggyCommit; upstream .mjs modules are saved byte-for-byte as .js and an import map redirects their .mjs relative imports.
